outcome: Change in weight z-score from birth to discharge
Increase in weight z-score across admission
cohort: The study included 910 neonates of <=34 weeks' gestation admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit or special care nursery between 2013 and 2017 in Victoria, Australia.
finding: Preterm SGA babies experienced a significantly smaller reduction in their weight z-score from birth to discharge compared to their appropriately grown counterparts (-0.62 SD vs -0.85 SD, p <.0001), and were four times more likely to experience an increase in their weight z-score during admission.
followup_time: From birth to discharge from neonatal intensive care unit or special care nursery
